question.text: Consider the logic circuit with inputs A, B, C and output \(Y\). How many combinations of \(A, B\) and \(C\) gives the output \(Y=0\) ?

solution.text:
Hint :
\(\begin{aligned} & \overline{(A+\overline{B})+\overline{C}}=\overline{A+\overline{B}} \cdot C=(\overline{A} \cdot B \cdot C) \\ & \therefore y=1 \\ & \text { if } A=0, B=1, C=1 \end{aligned}\) For rest of all cases \(Y=O\) Total cases \(=8\) \(\therefore\) Ans \((8-1)=7\)
